const item = $input.first().json;

const pipeline = item.video_pipeline_json;

if (!pipeline) {
  throw new Error("video_pipeline_json not found");
}

const scenes = pipeline.scenes || [];

if (!Array.isArray(scenes) || scenes.length === 0) {
  throw new Error("video_pipeline_json.scenes is empty or not an array");
}

const globalStyle = [
  "vertical 9:16 kids short-form animation storyboard frame",
  "production-ready keyframe for image-to-video motion",
  "clear readable action",
  "one main action per frame",
  "large simple objects",
  "consistent toy-like 3D world",
  "consistent characters across all scenes",
  "same main character design across all scenes",
  "same supporting character design across all scenes",
  "same central object design across all scenes",
  "same environment design across all scenes",
  "same color palette across all scenes",
  "bright colorful toy-like 3D animation",
  "soft cinematic lighting",
  "rounded safe shapes",
  "expressive character emotions",
  "clean background",
  "strong foreground subject",
  "safe family-friendly visual comedy",
  "modern animated kids short look",
  "clear staging for motion",
  "no random logos",
  "no readable UI",
  "no text inside the image",
  "no letters",
  "no captions",
  "no subtitles",
  "no signs",
  "no logos",
  "no watermark",
  "no typography",
  "no broken text",
  "no distorted objects"
].join(", ");

const noTextRule =
  "Do not render any text, letters, captions, subtitles, words, numbers, symbols, UI, signs, logos, watermark or typography inside the image. All captions and on-screen text will be added later in post-production, not inside the generated image.";

const continuityRule = [
  "This is one frame from a multi-scene storyboard for the same short video.",
  "Keep the same main character, supporting character, central object, environment, material style, lighting style and color palette across all scenes.",
  "Do not redesign the characters or world between scenes."
].join(" ");

const packages = scenes.map((scene, index) => {
  const sceneNumber = scene.scene || index + 1;
  const sceneId = `scene_${String(sceneNumber).padStart(2, "0")}`;

  const visual = scene.visual || "";
  const content = scene.content || "";
  const onScreenText = scene.on_screen_text || "";

  const keyframePrompt = [
    `Create one production storyboard keyframe for scene ${sceneNumber} of a vertical 9:16 kids animated short.`,
    `This frame must look like a clear still from a finished 3D animated episode, ready for image-to-video motion.`,
    `Scene block: ${scene.block || ""}.`,
    `Scene action: ${content}.`,
    `Visual composition: ${visual}.`,
    continuityRule,
    `Use a clear camera angle and readable staging. One main action only.`,
    `Make the frame feel like part of a coherent storyboard sequence, not a standalone random illustration.`,
    noTextRule,
    globalStyle
  ].filter(Boolean).join(" ");

  const dopPrompt = [
    `Animate this storyboard keyframe as a short vertical 9:16 kids animation scene.`,
    `Scene ${sceneNumber} action: ${content}.`,
    `Keep motion simple, readable and directly connected to the storyboard action.`,
    `Use subtle cinematic camera movement only if it supports the action.`,
    `Keep the same characters, environment, central object and color palette stable.`,
    `Do not introduce unrelated objects, new characters, random props or new locations.`,
    `Do not change the character design during motion.`,
    noTextRule
  ].filter(Boolean).join(" ");

  return {
    id: pipeline.id || item.id || "idea_001",
    title: String(pipeline.title || "").replace(/\*\*/g, "").trim(),
    language: pipeline.language || "en",
    duration_seconds: pipeline.duration_seconds || 18,
    aspect_ratio: pipeline.aspect_ratio || "9:16",

    scene_id: sceneId,
    scene_number: sceneNumber,
    block: scene.block || "",
    duration: scene.duration || "",
    content,
    visual,
    on_screen_text: onScreenText,

    keyframe_prompt: keyframePrompt,
    dop_prompt: dopPrompt,

    width_and_height: "1152x2048",
    quality: "720p",
    batch_size: 1,
    enhance_prompt: true,
    style_strength: 1,
    motions: null,

    constraints: [
      "must match the source script",
      "must match the scene visual direction",
      "must be suitable for vertical social video",
      "must be family-friendly",
      "must look like a production storyboard keyframe",
      "must support image-to-video motion",
      "must use one clear action per frame",
      "must strongly match the selected trend character archetype",
      "must strongly match the selected trend world grammar",
      "must keep characters consistent across scenes",
      "must keep environment consistent across scenes",
      "must keep central object consistent across scenes",
      "must avoid random logos",
      "must avoid readable UI",
      "must avoid text inside the image",
      "must avoid letters",
      "must avoid captions",
      "must avoid subtitles",
      "must avoid signs",
      "must avoid logos",
      "must avoid watermark",
      "must avoid typography",
      "must avoid broken text",
      "must avoid distorted objects"
    ]
  };
});

return [
  {
    json: {
      id: pipeline.id || item.id || "idea_001",
      status: "higgsfield_scene_packages_ready",
      source: "build-higgsfield-scene-packages",
      title: String(pipeline.title || "").replace(/\*\*/g, "").trim(),
      language: pipeline.language || "en",
      duration_seconds: pipeline.duration_seconds || 18,
      aspect_ratio: pipeline.aspect_ratio || "9:16",
      scene_packages: packages,
      source_video_pipeline_json: pipeline,
      completed_at: new Date().toISOString()
    }
  }
];

const item = $input.first().json;

function extractTrendBrief(input) {
  const text =
    input.output?.[0]?.content?.[0]?.text ||
    input.output?.content?.[0]?.text ||
    input.text ||
    "";

  if (!text) return input;

  const cleaned = text
    .replace(/^```json\s*/i, "")
    .replace(/^```\s*/i, "")
    .replace(/```$/i, "")
    .trim();

  try {
    return JSON.parse(cleaned);
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(`Trend brief JSON parse failed: ${error.message}`);
  }
}

const trendBrief = extractTrendBrief(item);

const allowedTrendFormats = [
  "hidden object reveal",
  "wrong vs right choice",
  "color sorting challenge",
  "size challenge",
  "before/after makeover",
  "rescue helper story",
  "satisfying assembly",
  "object matching puzzle",
  "funny safe fail loop",
  "collection reward",
  "guessing game",
  "tiny surprise reveal"
];

const repeatedPatternsToAvoid = [
  "rainbow ice cream",
  "magic machine",
  "toy cart",
  "key turns into food",
  "generic transformation payoff",
  "same helper character solves everything",
  "same two-cute-characters-in-toy-room setup"
];

const prompt = `
You are an Idea Parser Agent for an automated short-form kids video content machine.

Your task:
Convert the trend research brief into a structured creative brief for script generation.

Language requirements:
- Return everything in English.
- All fields must be in English.
- Do not use Russian.
- Do not use Cyrillic.
- Do not mix languages.
- Character names must be simple English-friendly names.
- On-screen text must be short English editing-layer text only.

Creative requirements:
- Choose exactly one selected_trend_format from the allowed list below.
- Build a structured creative control contract before writing story details.
- Use trend-native kids short-form mechanics freely: hidden object reveals, wrong-vs-right choices, sorting challenges, size challenges, safe fail loops, collection rewards, guessing games, and satisfying assembly.
- Do not make a generic cute story by default.
- The concept must have a fast visual hook in the first 1–2 seconds.
- The story must be understandable without dialogue.
- The structure must be suitable for an 18-second vertical video.
- Create a highly trend-similar character/world setup that matches the selected reference mechanics and visual grammar.
- Replicate the dominant trend mechanics as closely as possible: pacing, hook structure, scene rhythm, object logic, choice/reveal/sorting logic, emotional trigger and payoff pattern.
- Use the strongest available trend signals directly as creative direction when they improve recognizability and retention.
- Add a novelty_angle that makes this run visibly different from common default patterns.
- Explicitly avoid repeated default patterns unless the selected trend format truly requires one.
- Lock character identity, object identity, and world rules before scene generation.
- Build scene_contracts as strict visual/action contracts for storyboard and DoP motion prompts.

Safety requirements:
- Safe for children and family viewing.
- No violence.
- No fear or horror.
- No weapons.
- No fire.
- No injury.
- No medical scenes.
- No dangerous challenges.
- No adult themes.
- No toxic behavior.
- No manipulative calls to action.

Scene generation requirements:
- Generated visuals must contain no text.
- No letters.
- No numbers.
- No subtitles.
- No signs.
- No logos.
- No watermark.
- On-screen text will be added later in editing.

Allowed selected_trend_format values, choose exactly one:
${JSON.stringify(allowedTrendFormats, null, 2)}

Repeated patterns to avoid unless the chosen format absolutely requires them:
${JSON.stringify(repeatedPatternsToAvoid, null, 2)}

Input trend brief:
${JSON.stringify(trendBrief, null, 2)}

Return strict JSON only.
No markdown.
No comments before or after JSON.

Return JSON strictly in this structure:

{
  "id": "idea_001",
  "status": "parsed_idea_ready",

    }
  ],

  },
  "safety_rules": [],

}
`;

return [
  {
    json: {
      id: trendBrief.id || item.id || "idea_001",
      status: "idea_parser_prompt_ready",
      source: "build-idea-parser-prompt-from-trend-brief-en",
      trend_brief: trendBrief,
      idea_parser_prompt: prompt.trim(),
      completed_at: new Date().toISOString()
    }
  }
];

const items = $input.all();

const allowedVerdicts = new Set([
  "strong_candidate",
  "candidate"
]);

const candidates = items
  .map((item) => item.json)
  .filter((item) => allowedVerdicts.has(item.verdict))
  .filter((item) => item.unsafe_flag !== true)
  .filter((item) => item.brand_flag !== true)
  .filter((item) => item.non_kids_flag !== true)
  .filter((item) => Number(item.duration_seconds || 0) >= 7)
  .filter((item) => Number(item.duration_seconds || 0) <= 45)
  .sort((a, b) => Number(b.trend_score || 0) - Number(a.trend_score || 0));

const top = candidates.slice(0, 12);

const rejectedSummary = {
  total_input: items.length,
  total_allowed_candidates: candidates.length,
  selected_count: top.length,
  rejected_unsafe: items.filter((item) => item.json.unsafe_flag === true).length,
  rejected_brand_risk: items.filter((item) => item.json.brand_flag === true).length,
  rejected_non_kids: items.filter((item) => item.json.non_kids_flag === true).length
};

const trendPatterns = {
  recurring_mechanics: [
    "simple object transformation",
    "guessing game",
    "correct vs wrong comparison",
    "sharing / good behavior lesson",
    "colors and numbers learning",
    "secret room or hidden object",
    "vehicle or animal identification",
    "fast visual problem then quick resolution"
  ],
  pacing_notes: [
    "visual hook in the first 1–2 seconds",
    "one clear action per scene",
    "short loopable structure",
    "bright object appears early",
    "large readable character emotion",
    "minimal plot complexity"
  ],
  visual_notes: [
    "bright 3D cartoon look",
    "toy-like objects and characters",
    "high color contrast",
    "clean simple backgrounds",
    "large central object",
    "safe soft comedy",
    "expressive but non-scary faces"
  ],
  safety_notes: [
    "do not copy known characters or franchises",
    "avoid brand-like worlds and named IP",
    "avoid medical, war, political, scary or adult contexts",
    "avoid dangerous challenges",
    "avoid text rendered inside generated images"
  ]
};

return [
  {
    json: {
      status: "trend_references_selected",
      source: "youtube_trend_collector",
      selected_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      rejected_summary: rejectedSummary,
      trend_patterns: trendPatterns,
      top_references: top.map((item, index) => ({
        rank: index + 1,
        video_id: item.video_id,
        title: item.title,
        channel_title: item.channel_title,
        published_at: item.published_at,
        duration_seconds: item.duration_seconds,
        view_count: item.view_count,
        views_per_day: item.views_per_day,
        like_rate: item.like_rate,
        trend_score: item.trend_score,
        verdict: item.verdict,
        kids_signal_count: item.kids_signal_count,
        trend_mechanic_count: item.trend_mechanic_count,
        thumbnail_url: item.thumbnail_url,
        reference_url: `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${item.video_id}`
      }))
    }
  }
];

const item = $input.first().json;

const pipeline = item.video_pipeline_json;

if (!pipeline) {
  throw new Error("video_pipeline_json not found");
}

const scenes = pipeline.scenes || [];

if (!Array.isArray(scenes) || scenes.length === 0) {
  throw new Error("video_pipeline_json.scenes is empty or not an array");
}

const sceneLines = scenes.map((scene, index) => {
  const sceneNumber = scene.scene || index + 1;
  const contract = scene.scene_contract || {};

  return [
    `Frame ${sceneNumber}`,
    `Trend format: ${contract.selected_trend_format || pipeline.selected_trend_format || ""}`,
    `Clear action: ${contract.clear_action || scene.content || ""}`,
    `Start state: ${contract.action_start_state || ""}`,
    `End state: ${contract.action_end_state || ""}`,
    `Main character IDs: ${(contract.main_character_ids || []).join(", ")}`,
    `Central object IDs: ${(contract.central_object_ids || []).join(", ")}`,
    `Allowed motion: ${contract.allowed_motion || ""}`,
    `Camera motion: ${contract.camera_motion || ""}`,
    `Emotion: ${contract.emotion || ""}`,
    `Visual style: ${contract.visual_style || scene.visual || ""}`,
    `Background: ${contract.background || ""}`,
    `Objects that must not change: ${(contract.objects_that_must_not_change || []).join(", ")}`,
    `Forbidden substitutions: ${(contract.forbidden_object_substitutions || []).join(", ")}`,
    `Negative constraints: ${(contract.negative_constraints || []).join(", ")}`,
    `Quality positive constraints: ${(contract.quality_positive_constraints || []).join(", ")}`,
    `Quality negative constraints: ${(contract.quality_negative_constraints || []).join(", ")}`,
    `Object interaction rules: ${(contract.object_interaction_rules || []).join(", ")}`,
    `Loop/world constraints: ${(contract.same_world_loop_constraints || []).join(", ")}`,
    `Target scene duration seconds: ${scene.target_scene_duration_seconds || contract.target_scene_duration_seconds || ""}`,
    `Editing-layer caption only, not inside image: ${scene.on_screen_text || ""}`
  ].join("\n");
}).join("\n\n");

const storyboardPrompt = `
Create one vertical 9:16 storyboard sheet for a short kids animated video.

The storyboard sheet must contain exactly ${scenes.length} separate vertical 9:16 panels arranged in a clean 2-column by 3-row grid if there are 6 scenes.
Each panel must be a true vertical 9:16 mobile-short composition, not a square crop and not a horizontal crop.
Each panel should be designed for a mobile short with the main action centered safely inside the vertical frame.
No square panels.
No horizontal panels.
Leave only thin gutters between panels so each panel can be cropped as its own vertical 9:16 frame.
Each panel must show one scene from the same coherent animated episode.
The frames must feel like a professional pre-production storyboard for later image-to-video animation.

IMPORTANT VISUAL CONTINUITY:
Use the character_bible, object_bible, world_bible and consistency_groups as locked continuity rules.
Use the same main character identity in every frame where that character appears.
Use the same central object category, shape, color, size, material and style in every frame where that object appears.
Use the same world, material style, lighting style, color palette and camera language.
Do not redesign characters between frames.
Do not morph one object into another object.
Do not substitute the central object with food, toys, tools or unrelated props.
Do not change the world between frames.
Do not introduce random new characters or unrelated props.
No claymation.
No plasticine look.
No waxy melting surfaces.
No blob morphing.
No liquid morphing.
No body forming from soft blobs.
No organic merging between separate objects.
No smeared details.
No muddy textures.
No warped faces.
No unstable limbs.
No extra body parts.
No object category drift.
Wrong choices must never attach to the main character; they may approach, bump gently, wobble, or bounce away unchanged.
Only the correct object may attach; incorrect objects must remain separate and unchanged.
Scene 06 / Loop hint must stay in the same toy world: no doors, no windows, no interior room, no new location, no glass panel, no portal, no cut to another space.

STYLE:
Premium crisp 3D kids animation.
Clean geometry.
Sharp readable silhouettes.
Stable object shapes.
Consistent materials.
Polished non-melting surfaces.
Crisp facial details.
Clean mobile-short composition.
Bright toy-like 3D animation.
Rounded safe shapes.
Clean colorful kids short-form look.
Clear staging.
Large readable objects.
One main action per frame.
Expressive but safe emotions.
Soft cinematic lighting.
Production-ready keyframes for later motion animation.
Modern kids social-video visual rhythm.

NO TEXT POLICY:
Do not render any text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, subtitles, UI, logos, signs, watermarks or typography anywhere inside the image.
No text, letters, numbers, subtitles, UI, logos or watermarks inside panels.
Do not label the frames.
Do not add frame numbers.
All captions will be added later in post-production.

VIDEO TITLE:
${pipeline.title || ""}

VOICEOVER CONTEXT:
${pipeline.voiceover || ""}

SELECTED TREND FORMAT:
${pipeline.selected_trend_format || ""}

CHARACTER BIBLE:
${JSON.stringify(pipeline.character_bible || [], null, 2)}

OBJECT BIBLE:
${JSON.stringify(pipeline.object_bible || [], null, 2)}

WORLD BIBLE:
${JSON.stringify(pipeline.world_bible || {}, null, 2)}

CONSISTENCY GROUPS:
${JSON.stringify(pipeline.consistency_groups || [], null, 2)}

SCENES:
${sceneLines}

OUTPUT:
A single vertical 9:16 storyboard sheet image made from six separate vertical 9:16 panels.
No square panels.
No horizontal panels.
No written labels.
No text.
No logos.
No watermark.
`;

return [
  {
    json: {
      id: pipeline.id || item.id || "idea_001",
      status: "openai_storyboard_payload_ready",
      source: "build-openai-storyboard-payload",
      title: String(pipeline.title || "").replaceAll("**", "").trim(),
      language: pipeline.language || "en",
      duration_seconds: pipeline.duration_seconds || 18,
      aspect_ratio: pipeline.aspect_ratio || "9:16",
      scene_count: scenes.length,
      storyboard_prompt: storyboardPrompt.trim(),
      storyboard_sheet_layout: {
        columns: 2,
        rows: 3,
        panel_aspect_ratio: "9:16",
        target_frame_width: 720,
        target_frame_height: 1280
      },
      openai_image_payload: {
        model: "gpt-image-2",
        prompt: storyboardPrompt.trim(),
        size: "1024x1792",
        quality: "medium",
        output_format: "png",
        n: 1
      },
      source_video_pipeline_json: pipeline,
      completed_at: new Date().toISOString()
    }
  }
];
